description:
## What the module actually is

src/telemetry/causal.rs (1960 lines) is the assertion vocabulary of the compiler's own test suite. Measured: exactly three files name CausalReport --

  src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs   lib unit tests for the telemetry projection
  tests/fz2_cli.rs                     target-fixture acceptance (zero uncaused, pinned work counts)
  src/compiler2/pull.rs                only inside its #[cfg(test)] mod tests (opens 2559)

No binary, no production path. It is 'pub use telemetry::causal' out of lib.rs:29, so it LOOKS like a published analysis library, but nothing ships against it and its whole consumer set is tests.

## What is load-bearing vs incidental

Load-bearing: .uncaused (17 uses -- the north-star invariant that every re-run named a moved input), formula_totals/product_totals (10/9 -- pinned per-fixture work counts), canonical_multiset (6 -- the cross-run comparand), .sessions (19), .formulas/.products.

One consumer only, all public_trace_test.rs: .product_publications, .final_population, .lifecycles, .shifts, derive_requests(). Not automatically waste -- .lifecycles proves the retract-and-remint signature and .undefined_first_uses proves the self-describing contract -- but the surface is one assertion deep in five places and worth a look when the arc restructures it.

Dead: distinct_demanded_products() has zero callers anywhere including inside causal.rs. It is pub, so dead_code cannot see it. Delete with fz-0am.4.

## The decision, now settled

The earlier framing offered two answers -- test support, or unshipped production. The consumer measurement settles it: this is test scaffolding, so it goes to a dev-dependency crate the way fz-foq.1 moved fixture metadata. Coupling to the lib is one enum (handler::EventKind, 6 uses); cargo permits the cycle through the dev-dependency edge.

The rejected alternative, keeping it in the lib against a future fz2 subcommand that reads a trace, is not supported by anything in the tree: the CLI writes traces (--log-telemetry) and ships nothing that reads one. If such a subcommand is ever wanted, moving the crate back is cheap; leaving 1650 lines of test vocabulary in the compiler on that speculation is not.

## Sequence

Blocked by fz-0am: that arc removes ~275-300 lines of inference and folds Cause into WorkStartReason. Move what remains, not what is there now.

comments.text:
Investigated: the filed plan does not work, and the real finding is larger.

Why 'move the 3 helpers into tests/fz2_cli.rs' fails:
- functions() is on CanonTables and reads the PRIVATE field self.functions (causal.rs:122). Moving it out would require making that field pub -- a wider surface than the one being removed.
- formula_totals/product_totals are not fz2_cli-only. src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs calls them at 10+ sites. Moving them into fz2_cli.rs would duplicate them, not relocate them.

The real finding: src/telemetry/causal.rs (1960 lines) has ZERO production consumers.
- pull.rs's three causal:: references are all inside its #[cfg(test)] mod tests (opens at 2559).
- public_trace.rs is itself a #[cfg(test)]-gated module.
- No CLI or binary use.

It cannot simply be gated, because tests/fz2_cli.rs consumes it as an external crate and cannot see cfg(test) -- the same constraint that drove fz-foq.1.

Its only coupling to the lib is `use super::handler::EventKind` (6 occurrences of a plain enum), so a fz-foq.1-style extraction to a dev-dependency crate is feasible; the crate would depend on fz for EventKind, which cargo permits because the fz -> crate edge is a dev-dependency.

Needs a decision before proceeding -- see the rewritten description.

Blocked by fz-0am. Before deciding where causal analysis should live, decide how much of it should exist: ~669 lines of Replay reconstruct a link the scheduler holds at enqueue time. Answering fz-0am changes what is left to house.

title: Move causal to a dev-dependency crate after fz-0am shrinks it
